slides.headline: Know Exactly What To Order
slides.description: Title slide: kicker label, headline text, and a thin accent line on a dark gradient background. No bullet list, diagram, or chart is shown.
bullets: MenuMatch turns uncertainty into confident decisions
Recommendations arrive in seconds, not endless searching
Every suggestion reflects real customer experiences
slides.narration: MenuMatch answers the question every unfamiliar diner asks: what should I order here? It transforms a confusing menu into confident, evidence-backed choices.

slides.headline: From Menu Photo To Restaurant Match
slides.description: Editorial slide: kicker label, headline, and a bordered box containing the slide's bullet points as the on-screen text.
bullets: One photo captures dishes, prices, categories, and images
GPS and menu clues identify the exact restaurant branch
Confidence scores surface uncertainty before recommendations
slides.narration: The experience starts with one menu photo. AI reads the menu, combines it with location signals, and confirms the restaurant with a transparent confidence score.

slides.headline: Reviews Become Dish-Level Intelligence
slides.description: Illustrated pipeline diagram: kicker, headline, and numbered circular stages connected by downward arrows, each labeled with a step of the process.
bullets: AI connects reviews to specific menu items
Misspellings, translations, and descriptions still match
Sentiment analysis explains what diners actually liked
slides.narration: Instead of treating reviews as general opinions, MenuMatch identifies dish-level signals, even across languages, misspellings, and indirect descriptions, then explains the reasons behind sentiment.

slides.headline: Five Recommendations, One Clear Answer
slides.description: Scorecard slide: kicker, headline, and a bordered box listing label/value stat rows summarizing the project's real scope.
bullets: Top picks span appetisers, mains, signatures, desserts, and drinks
Rankings combine popularity, sentiment, recency, and photos
Each recommendation includes plain-language review evidence
slides.narration: Customers receive a curated pick for every major category. Rankings balance popularity, sentiment, recency, signature status, and photo frequency, with evidence that is easy to understand.

slides.headline: Trust That Improves With Every Choice
slides.description: Closing slide: kicker label and headline on a dark gradient background, matching the opening slide's style. No bullet list, diagram, or chart is shown.
bullets: Human confirmation handles uncertain restaurant or dish matches
Likes capture personal feedback for better future rankings
MenuMatch makes discovery faster, clearer, and more trustworthy
slides.narration: Trust is built into the product. When AI is uncertain, customers can confirm the match, and every like helps MenuMatch make future recommendations more personal and precise.
